dbToolScopingDenylist.digest_agent_runs: Append-only audit of agent runs; written only by typed actions. No UI or agent tool needs raw SQL access to it.
dbToolScopingDenylist.digest_opportunities: Shared team room by design: every teammate sees every opportunity. All reads/writes go through typed actions (list-room, post-digest, claim-opportunity); the agent's raw SQL tools are deliberately denied this table.
dbToolScopingDenylist.digest_room_messages: Shared team room by design: the agent's message log is visible to every teammate. All writes go through typed actions (post-digest, claim-opportunity, post-eod-summary, seed-demo); the agent's raw SQL tools are deliberately denied this table.
dbToolScopingDenylist.digest_task_cards: Shared team room by design: every teammate sees every task card. All reads/writes go through typed actions (list-room, claim-opportunity); the agent's raw SQL tools are deliberately denied this table.
